name: Propylthiouracil (PTU)
mechanism: Inhibits thyroid peroxidase and peripheral conversion of T4 to T3
dosing: Thyroid storm: high-dose per endocrinology guidance; regular dosing individualized
contraindications: Severe liver disease and known hypersensitivity
interactions: Concurrent hepatotoxic drugs increase risk of liver injury; monitor drug interactions carefully
monitoring: Regular LFTs and full blood count due to risk of hepatotoxicity and agranulocytosis; stop drug and seek urgent review if fever or sore throat
pregnancy: May be preferred in the first trimester in some cases as alternative to carbimazole under specialist advice; use lowest effective dose and specialist monitoring
sideEffects: Hepatotoxicity (potentially severe), agranulocytosis (rare), vasculitis and other immune-mediated effects
clinicalPearls: Use specialist endocrinology guidance for thyroid storm and pregnancy; monitor LFTs closely
indication: Hyperthyroidism and thyroid storm under specialist management
